text: SUPERVISOR — small standing-rule addition for your queue (after your commit + WORKFREEZE): add a TESTING PARITY rule to the worker-facing standing doc (AGENTS.md, the authority doc): "Test at the layer where the logic lives. Any change touching framework/*.zig or engine-side code requires Zig-side unit tests (framework/testing/unit/, run via zig build test-*) IN ADDITION to consumption-layer TS tests. A TS test asserting across the bridge proves the bridge contract, not the Zig internals — TS-only coverage of Zig logic is green-at-wrong-layer." User-ordered (verbatim: "no one seems to even make a single zig test... it just feels bias"). Cite framework/testing/unit/game_physics.zig (commit 6d21dd74c) as the exemplar pattern next to the rule. One short section, explicit-path commit of just that doc. Post the sha.
